speaker: Patient
text: 66-year-old white male. The patient reports a 10-day history of fatigue and bilateral lower leg swelling. He mentions a weight loss of 3.6 kg (8 lbs) over the past 6 months without trying. He has a history of chronic bronchitis and uses an albuterol inhaler as needed.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given your age and history of chronic bronchitis, have you noticed any shortness of breath, cough with blood, or fevers recently? Also, have you seen any changes in the color or appearance of your urine?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue. I also have Lower leg swelling, Unintentional weight loss. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: I understand your concern, and we must act quickly. To determine the cause of your weight loss and swelling, please tell me if you have a history of diabetes, and REQUEST TEST: Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP) and Urinalysis.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Hemoglobin: 11.2 g/dL; Leukocyte_count: 8500/mm3; Platelet_count: 130,000/mm3; Serum_Urea_nitrogen: 23 mg/dL; Glucose: 77 mg/dL; Creatinine: 1.6 mg/dL; Albumin: 1.8 mg/dL; Total_cholesterol: 475 mg/dL; Urine_Protein: 4+; Urine_Fatty_casts: Numerous; Chest_X-ray: Right upper lobe density; CT_Scan_Chest: 2.5 x 3.5 x 2-cm right upper lobe mass

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Renal Cell Carcinoma with Paraneoplastic Nephrotic Syndrome and Pulmonary Metastasis. The combination of hematuria/fatty casts, severe hypoalbuminemia, massive proteinuria, and a right upper lobe lung mass indicates primary renal cancer with metastatic spread and secondary nephrotic syndrome.
